record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare LEAF_BLADE in this production reference. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), maxPP, atk and passive. Kartana's passive BEAST_BOOST_ATK is not investigated.
record.summary: Deals one hit of TRUE-type damage to the cast target: the caster's current atk x a star-indexed percentage (100/125/150), rounded. The hit is passed as a crit unconditionally (the cast's own crit roll is ignored), and AP also scales it because apBoost defaults to true. No movement and no status.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to process (the unit's current attack target); no retargeting or area
targeting.note: Target selection before the cast and range handling were not read.

geometry.shape: single target; no area, no movement

effects.scaling: raw = round(caster atk x percent / 100) read at cast time; then AP: damage x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost defaults true); then the crit multiplier 1 + (critPower - 1) x factor, applied because crit is passed as true (factor 1 for TRUE: rocky helmet and black augurite do not reduce it)
effects.resolution: TRUE damage is not divided by DEF or SPE_DEF and skips the flat reductions of non-true damage; then ceil, minimum 1 and later untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (no reflection for TRUE)

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (250) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the five units (3,2,3,3,1). Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy; it only needs a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes: each cast reads the caster's current atk and deals one hit.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 100/125/150 percent of the caster's atk (1-3 stars). Damage dealt is that amount x (1 + AP/100) x the crit multiplier (crit is always passed as true), with no defence division, then ceil (min 1) and untraced modifiers. The percentage alone is not a damage amount.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers) - only the TRUE branch (no defence division, skipped flat reductions) and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the base process and castAbility were read
